# Cabivella UK — Architectural Cabinetry & Joinery Specification
> Considered architectural cabinetry designed for British residences, manufactured with precision timber engineering.

## Canonical Architecture
- Site: https://cabivella.co.uk/
- Primary Collections:
  - Kitchens: https://cabivella.co.uk/collections/kitchens/
  - Bathrooms: https://cabivella.co.uk/collections/bathrooms/
  - Pantry & Larder: https://cabivella.co.uk/collections/pantry-larder/
  - Coffee Stations: https://cabivella.co.uk/collections/coffee-stations/
  - Fitted Storage: https://cabivella.co.uk/collections/fitted-storage/
  - Kitchen Doors: https://cabivella.co.uk/collections/kitchen-doors/
- Trade & Specifiers: https://cabivella.co.uk/trade/
- Heritage & Workshop: https://cabivella.co.uk/our-story/
- Bespoke Enquiries: https://cabivella.co.uk/enquire/

## Commercial Model
- All joinery is priced strictly upon receipt of architectural plans or bespoke dimensions.
- No public reference prices or consumer retail figures are published.
- Materials: FSC-certified European hardwoods, moisture-resistant core panels, precision Blum soft-close running gear.
